# ZekoraPay

> ZekoraPay is a comprehensive financial and enterprise platform built around two dedicated applications:
> - **ZekoraPay App (Personal & Associations — https://app.zekorapay.com)**: Multi-currency fiat (XAF, XOF, EUR, USD...) and crypto wallets, Mobile Money deposits/withdrawals, instant transfers, virtual prepaid cards, currency conversion, digital tontines & associations, QR merchant checkout, online shop, event ticketing, rentals booking, donation campaigns, end-to-end encrypted messaging with video meetings, and an AI assistant.
> - **ZekoraPay Pro (B2B & Enterprises — https://pro.zekorapay.com)**: Multi-employee accounts with granular permissions, multi-admin PIN approval workflows, enterprise treasury & bulk transfers, automated payroll, invoicing & custom-branded PDF exports (Word-style enterprise header/footer), multi-warehouse stock & POS shops, real-estate rental management, fleet delivery, cash-in/cash-out agent network, public developer APIs, and AI governance cockpit.

Both ZekoraPay App and ZekoraPay Pro are live on Web, installable as Progressive Web Apps (PWA), and distributed as Android APKs directly from each application. ZekoraPay provides payment, wallet, savings-group, commerce, and enterprise financial operations (it is not a speculative trading or investment advisory platform).

## User guide

- [Guide](https://zekorapay.com/guide): step-by-step documentation with screenshots for account creation & KYC, wallets, transfers, cash-in/cash-out, conversion, virtual cards, merchant QR, tontines & associations, events & ticketing, enterprise Pro workspace, rentals & real estate, shop, donations, video meetings, and agents.

## Developer API

- [API documentation](https://zekorapay.com/docs): public REST API for third-party integrations — API keys, HMAC-SHA256 webhooks, granular scopes, wallets, merchant payments, exchange, shop, donations, events, cards, users. Base URL: `https://api.app.zekorapay.com/public-api-gateway/v1`.
